<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Ghoul Stalker](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3009)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Ghouls stalkers are ravenous undead who haunt graveyards and eat corpses.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Undead](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46)): DC 15

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 10
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Ghoul_Stalker.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 1">[Ghoul Stalker](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3009)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Ghoul" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=754" />
<trait label="Undead" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=722" />
<trait label="Unholy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=521" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 163

**Perception** +7; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Necril](/Languages.aspx?ID=20)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +7, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +8, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +7, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +5

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +1

**Dex** +4

**Con** +1

**Int** +1

**Wis** +2

**Cha** +2
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 17 

**Fort** +4 

**Ref** +9 

**Will** +5 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 16
([void healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=83))

</row>

**Immunities**
bleed, [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571) effects, [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=578), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669), [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95)

**[Stench](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=76)** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=542), [olfactory](/Traits.aspx?ID=664)) 10 feet, DC 14

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet, burrow 5 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +9 ([Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)),
**Damage** 1d8+1 piercing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
claw +9 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)),
**Damage** 1d6+1 slashing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45)

**Consume Flesh** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) 1d6 HP

**Ghoul Whispers** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [Linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=101), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) DC 17

**Grave Knowledge**  ([Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) +7 skill modifier

**Swift Leap** <actions string="Single Action" />  (move)

</column>
